fieldNotes.truckGate: The plant's perimeter access road connects to the industrial-park internal road network as an open, uncontrolled drive; no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point visible in satellite imagery. Street View (2021-06) only reaches Woodland Ave at the separate brick office building - it does not reach the plant's truck entrance, hence medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth resolvable at the access road. Small structures along the dock faces read as dock-side utility buildings, not an entrance guard shack.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: A perimeter access road fully wraps the building plus a long approach from the internal park road - ample queue room.
fieldNotes.dropArea: North drop yard holds trailers parked nose-out in dense rows; ~40+ stalls, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock doors along both the north and south building faces with many trailers backed in; ~45 total estimated, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two distinct dock banks - a large dock cluster + drop yard on the north face and a smaller dock bank on the south face - suggests separate ship/receive flows; medium confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide perimeter road and large open paved aprons with no existing control structure - room to add a bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Bloomfield is within the Hartford CT metro; the plant sits in an industrial-park setting with several large commercial buildings nearby (though wooded/wetland buffers surround the parcel). Called Urban.
fieldNotes.rooftopSolar: The plant has a full rooftop solar array (registered as the 'Niagara Bottling - Bloomfield' solar installation).
